cutList.derivation: The shelf is a strut across its tilt (angled-parts 1.5): from its back edge's centreline, 2" in and 18" up, to its front edge's, 10" in and 12" up: d = (0, 8, -6) in, 8^2 + 6^2 = 10^2, so 10" across exactly. Reference Y: local Z = d x Y = (6, 0, 0), the shelf's 30" length, which is its Depth; its Height is the 3/4" thickness, in the drawn face (the end profile). Both ends are cut to Y (the back panel's face, a plumb front edge), square to local Z, so plain mitres. Setback = 3/4 x (n_y / n_d) with y = z x d = (0, 36, 48) scaled: n_y = 36/60 = 0.6, n_d = 8/10 = 0.8, so 3/4 x 3/4 = 9/16" = 576, exact. Width (planAxes x = width, invariant 16) = 10 + 9/16 = 10 9/16" = 10816, exact. Length = Depth = 30" = 2'-6"; thickness = Height = 3/4". Corners: first end SW (sign(d.Y) x sign(y.Y) > 0), second NE: a parallelogram. atan(576/768) = 36.87 degrees -> 37 to the half degree, not 45 so marked. The out-of-plane dimension is the length, so each sentence ends 'for the full 2'-6" length' (shaped-parts 4.4).

cutList.label: Side
cutList.derivation: Each side stands 3/4" x 12" in the plan and 24" tall: planAxes x = thickness, y = width, so its length is its depth, 24" = 24576 = 2'-0". Label: common prefix 'Side, ' -> 'Side'.
